title: Casper and the Hollow
premise: Odile Montrose's ledgers hide a secret: the Hollow, a dying realm beneath the city, survives only because the Scribes' Guild has been quietly selling its memories to pay a covenant debt. When a dying courier gives her the original map of the covenant — and the guild marks her for death — Odile flees into the Hollow with Casper, a debt-collector's son who knows the tunnels better than anyone. Together they discover the covenant can be reforged only by returning what was stolen, which means the surface world must give up the memories that keep it prosperous. In the end, Odile pays the final price herself, surrendering her own name to the ledger so both realms survive, and Casper carries her story back into the light.
about_author: Sebastian Reyes is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloging condemned buildings before turning to fiction. He writes fantasy about paperwork, debts, and the people who keep impossible systems running.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. She balances the guild's books and notices entries that shouldn't exist — payments made in memories. Establishes her precision, her debt-bond, and her quiet hunger for freedom. Emotional beat: restless unease disguised as competence.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Door
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. A bleeding courier collapses in the scriptorium and presses a wax-sealed map into her hands, whispering that the covenant is breaking. Guild enforcers arrive minutes later. Emotional beat: terror and the first taste of choice.

chapters.title: Terms of Debt
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The guild accuses her of theft; her debt-bond is called due as leverage. She learns the Master Scribe knew about the Hollow all along. Emotional beat: betrayal by the institution she served faithfully.

chapters.title: The Boy Who Knows the Dark
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Introduced fleeing guild collectors through the undercity with his father's old route-maps. He witnesses Odile's escape and, seeing his father's seal on her map, follows her. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into purpose.

chapters.title: Down the Stair That Isn't There
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Odile and Casper meet badly, then ally out of necessity, descending through a door that exists only at certain hours. The Hollow's air tastes like forgetting. Emotional beat: wary trust forged in fear.

chapters.title: The Hollow Below
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. They reach the Hollow: a beautiful, dimming realm whose people are literally fading as their memories are sold off. A child doesn't recognize her own mother. Emotional beat: horror at what prosperity costs.

chapters.title: What My Father Collected
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Casper reveals his father was the covenant's last sworn courier, killed for refusing to hand over the map. His loyalty to a dead man drives him forward. Emotional beat: inherited guilt and love.

chapters.title: The Fading Court
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. They petition the Hollow's regent, who is too far gone to remember the covenant's terms. Only the original map — written in blood-ink — can restore them. Emotional beat: despair at leaders who forgot their duty.

chapters.title: Hunters on the Stair
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Guild hunters breach the Hollow. First real combat; Casper is wounded covering Odile's escape deeper into the tunnels. Emotional beat: the cost of loyalty made physical.

chapters.title: The Memory Markets
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. They find where stolen memories are stored and sold — including, Odile realizes with dread, some of her own childhood. Emotional beat: violation; the past itself has been mortgaged.

chapters.title: A Name I Sold
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile recovers one vial of her own memories and relives why she signed her debt-bond: she once traded her mother's memory to save her brother. Emotional beat: shame, and self-forgiveness beginning.

chapters.title: The Terms of the Covenant
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Deciphering the map, they learn the covenant requires willing payment from both realms — not theft. The guild's whole economy is built on a broken promise. Emotional beat: righteous anger.

chapters.title: The Regent's Last Memory
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The dying regent gives them the final clue: the covenant must be sealed at the Well of Names by someone who owes nothing. Neither of them qualifies. Emotional beat: hope curdling into impossibility.

chapters.title: Betrayal in the Tunnels
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. A Hollow guide sells them out to the guild for a promised restoration of his family's memories. Casper is captured; Odile escapes with the map. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. survival, brutally staged.

chapters.title: The Price Offered
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The Master Scribe offers Odile freedom and her brother's safety if she surrenders the map. She sees the trap but also the truth: someone must pay. Emotional beat: temptation weighed against conscience.

chapters.title: Rescue at the Well Road
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Odile returns for Casper, burning her leverage to do it. Their rescue succeeds because the fading Hollow folk, moved by her sacrifice, rise up. Emotional beat: loyalty answered with loyalty.

chapters.title: The Uprising of the Forgotten
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The Hollow's people storm the memory markets to reclaim their names. Chaos, fire, and grief; the guild's vaults break open. Emotional beat: cathartic fury.

chapters.title: Confrontation at the Ledger
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile faces the Master Scribe among the burning archives. He argues the trade saved both realms from ruin; she answers that survival bought with theft isn't survival. Emotional beat: the theme stated in blood and ink.

chapters.title: The Well of Names
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. At the well, the covenant demands a debtor with no remaining obligations. Odile realizes her debt-bond, her guilt, everything binds her — except her name, which she never truly owned. Emotional beat: terrible clarity.

chapters.title: What Odile Paid
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Odile writes her name into the covenant and steps into the well, giving her identity to bind the realms. The Hollow blooms; the surface dims gently, honestly. Casper screams her name — and it begins to fade. Emotional beat: devastating sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Ledger Keeper
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Weeks later, Casper becomes the new keeper of the restored covenant, writing down every memory of Odile he can recover before they vanish. He finds one entry in her handwriting she left behind. Emotional beat: mourning transformed into devotion.

chapters.title: A Story Worth Keeping
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, closing. Reading her final entry — instructions, an apology, and a single line: 'Remember me wrong if you must, but remember me' — Casper chooses to tell her story aloud, and somewhere in the Hollow, a scribe with no name pauses, feeling remembered. Emotional beat: bittersweet resurrection through story.
